1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having a plurality of conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, wherein the opening is formed by __removing at least a portion of a solder mask layer and exposing an underlying core layer__; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening and extends above the chip mounting surface__.

2. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a bottom surface of the opening __and is in contact with the underlying core layer__.

3. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a sidewall of the opening __and is in contact with the underlying core layer__.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Cancelled)

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface, __wherein the stiffening microstructure is spaced apart from the integrated circuit chip__.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure __includes__ a lid __having a thickness greater than the solder mask layer__.

9. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip, __wherein the heat transfer medium fills a gap between the lid and the integrated circuit chip__.

10. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring __having an outer diameter greater than an inner diameter, and wherein the ring is bonded to at least one of the bottom surface or sidewall of the opening__.

11. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the ground reference plane layer is in contact with the stiffening microstructure, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is electrically isolated from the ground reference plane layer by a dielectric material__.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, __wherein the opening is formed by removing at least a portion of a solder mask layer and exposing an underlying core layer__; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening and extends above the chip mounting surface__.

20. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the ground reference plane layer, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is electrically isolated from the ground reference plane layer by a dielectric material__.
